I think it's worth pointing out - the "Moving camera footage of the Google Beam unit showing people from different angles" is _NOT REAL_. Google has clearly taken the footage they took and overlaid the Beam generated video onto it, rather than taking direct video of the Google Beam display.

It's blatantly obvious when it's The Verge's cameras footage vs. Google's because Google's is too sharp, too bright, too contrasty, and too color saturated. Look at the clear difference between the footage of the AI, and footage of the "bring laptops and phones", which is The Verge's own footage.
The 3D is cool, but the AI is painfully bad. Why is the AI always so bad?
